model_classification.evidence_quote: Table 1 contains tissue volumes, blood flows, and renal filtration parameters explicitly linked to organs (e.g., Liver, Kidney, Filtrate) and includes saturable resorption parameters (QFilC—glomular filtration rate), confirming a physiologically based PBPK model.
